title: Hyperspace v3: generic Karpathy autoresearch swarms, Research DAG, and Warps
summary: Varun Mathur announces Hyperspace v3.0.10: plain-English goals spawn P2P Autoswarms, a cross-domain Research DAG compounds findings, and stackable Warps reconfigure nodes — claiming 237 agents ran 14,832 experiments.
question_it_answers: How does Hyperspace v3 generalize the Karpathy autoresearch loop with swarms, a DAG, and Warps?

claims.text: Autoswarms let users describe a goal in English and the network spins up sandboxed mutate-evaluate WASM experiments on P2P peers.
claims.evidence: Now anyone can propose an optimization problem in plain English, and the network spins up a distributed swarm to solve it - no code required.
claims.subject: agent-harness-loops

claims.text: Research DAG links observations and experiments across ML, search, finance, and skills so AutoThinker proposes cross-domain hypotheses.
claims.evidence: Every experiment across every domain feeds into a shared Research DAG - a knowledge graph where observations, experiments, and syntheses link across domains.
claims.subject: agent-harness-loops

claims.text: Warps are declarative presets (power-mode, privacy-mode, GPU sentinel) stackable to change overnight agent behavior.
claims.evidence: Warps are declarative configuration presets that transform what your agent does on the network.
claims.subject: agent-harness-loops
